title: Noodling Nudibranch
statement: This ruffled, lilac-and-tangerine sea slug drifts slowly through a dim, moonlit kelp garden. It leaves faint bioluminescent trails that loop into curious doodles (spirals, question marks, the occasional almost-word) before they fade away. When a visitor lingers at the glass, it pauses mid-scribble and turns its feathery rhinophores toward them, as if it's genuinely interested in what they might say next.
